column1: # The reviewed digest of every two-sided wire vector, and the test that writes it.
# A fixture here is written by a Rust encoder and re-derived by a TypeScript
# one. Each authoring test accepts DCLUTCH_WRITE_WIRE_VECTOR=1, which rewrites
# the fixture -- the right way for a deliberate move to land, and also the way
# a wire moves with every gate still green. This column is the half a human has
